summary: Added a custom argparse type validator `_positive_int` to reject negative or zero IDs before storage lookup. This provides clearer error messages and validates input at the argument parsing stage.

changes.description: Added `_positive_int` function for validating positive integer IDs, updated argument definitions for done/undone/rm commands to use this validator, and modified `main()` to catch SystemExit from argparse and return 1
Added 7 regression tests for negative/zero ID validation across all ID-accepting commands

risks: Minor behavior change: argparse SystemExit now caught and returns 1 instead of exiting process
